MESSAGE.value:
Implemented most of the functions
Bishop tests can now run without crashing with "Not Implemented" exceptions. Ready to implement pieve movement logic.
Added functionality to ChessPiece so that the BishopMoveTests pass. Overridden toString, hashCode, and equals functions added to ChessMove, ChessPiece, and ChessPosition
Added comments in bishopMoves(), documentation comments for new methods/functions, and and added one forgotten equals function in ChessPiece. Bishop move tests still pass
Implemented function rookMoves(). The rook move tests now pass
Implemented function queenMoves(). The rook move tests now pass. Rook and Queen were very fast because their code was almost identical to the bishop's.
Implemented function kingMoves. Tests pass. Code is similar to queenMoves, but adjusted to not be long-range.
Implemented function knightMoves(). Tests pass. Code is similar to kingMoves, but adjusted to not check for the 8 adjacent spaces, but rather for the 8 spaces of the knight's wheel.
Implemented function pawnMoves(). This was the trickiest. I better understand the choices made when designing the class hierarchy now. All tests pass
Implemented the resetBoard() function, now passes tests. Also overrode toString, hashCode, and equals() methods/functions in ChessBoard. Documentation comments added.
